assumptions: Synthetic trajectories are adequate for a workflow demo
Greedy dispatch is fixed across arms
hypotheses.falsification_rule: Mean relative reduction below 0.15 or any non-finite output.
hypotheses.statement: In the toy 168-hour environment, increasing storage energy capacity from 24 to 48 MWh while holding power at 8 MW will reduce mean unmet demand by at least 15% across paired seeds.
